answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks through a raven sentinel that clusters device fingerprints and applies a superlinear bond requirement. The first identity posts a base bond of 100 units locked for 72 hours; each additional name under the same cluster costs double the previous and remains locked for the full period which no fee can shorten. A single detection event sends a ripple that freezes all linked identities across the shared tundra of compute until each provides a unique non-amortizable proof of distinct work.
